specificNotes.D93-A05: Tavo 0.93 accepted at least one minAppVersion boundary that the spec-2 validator expected to reject.
specificNotes.D93-A08: Malformed or unsafe localization catalogs were accepted in several package paths, including catalog and symlink canaries.
specificNotes.D93-A10: An unsupported $t placement was accepted instead of being rejected.
specificNotes.D93-B02: The phone proved OpenAI Chat Completions JSON/SSE against the virtual provider; Responses and legacy Completions were not both completed through the UI.
specificNotes.D93-B05: Fable 5 controls and persistence were visible, but the local-wire action repeatedly ended in the same client TypeError before a request reached the fixture.
specificNotes.D93-B06: Mythos 5 controls and persistence were visible; proprietary wire fields could not be captured after the same redirect blocker.
specificNotes.D93-C05: OpenRouter ASR was present in the selector, but its audio-chat wire shape could not be redirected safely to the local provider.
specificNotes.D93-C09: A nominally too-short 250 ms hold unexpectedly emitted an ASR request; the other gesture observations are partial.
specificNotes.D93-F08: Append, insert, and update worked, but an actual delete did not make the message return not-found.
specificNotes.D93-G01: Native maximum-field character roundtrip lost character_book data.
specificNotes.D93-G04: PNG embed/extract succeeded, while the imported character readback was incomplete.
specificNotes.D93-HCF35: The thread switch completed, but the TavoJS current-chat readback did not match the selected chat.
specificNotes.D93-J03: Backup B mutation covered chat, character, persona, lorebook, regex, preset, and plugin plus a separate spec-2 config/enabled/runtime drill; it did not mutate every provider/theme/binding family.
specificNotes.N93-04: Fable 5 UI and restart persistence passed; local wire capture was blocked by the repeatable client TypeError.
specificNotes.N93-05: Mythos 5 UI and persistence passed; local wire capture was blocked.
specificNotes.N93-06: OpenRouter and custom ASR configuration/persistence were observed; real OpenRouter and local audio-chat wire validation remain blocked.
specificNotes.N93-07: Long-press send and multipart ASR passed; cancel/fill/fault coverage was incomplete and the too-short hold emitted a request.
specificNotes.N93-08: The new binding selector and retained test binding were observed, but the full choose/cancel/reopen matrix was incomplete.
specificNotes.N93-12: Protected chat, input, primary API, theme, persona, preset, permissions, IME, and plugins were restored. The sole retained test image provider remains shown as current because Tavo 0.93 has no unset action.
specificNotes.P93-04: minAppVersion readback worked, but boundary rejection behavior was inconsistent with the expected validator.
specificNotes.P93-05: Localization manifests installed and rendered, but unsafe catalog validation and runtime locale/fallback hooks were not complete.
specificNotes.P93-09: Deterministic generation, ASR, TTS, and image paths produced usable request evidence, but the entire hooks/input/TTS regression matrix was not completed.
specificNotes.P93-10: Backup B restored the spec-2 plugin's exact config, disabled state, and zero runtime contributions after a discriminating enabled mutation.
specificNotes.M93-99: Strict final ADB/MCP and protected-state gates passed. Verdict remains mixed because the retained sole image provider cannot be unset without deleting it.
